note: A0f pilot: the entire 196-skill seed library deployed to each task (instead of that task's own ~2.7 shipped skills), evaluated at --max-iterations 0. reward_opt is this arm's measured score, not an optimized one -- there is no optimizer loop here, so this reuses transfer-eval-8fold's field convention rather than its literal meaning. reward_baseline is the task's own seed score (A0) from results/results.json (task-by-task-87 sweep, generated 2026-08-28); reward_opt is the A0f measurement. The mean delta (-0.154, -24.5% relative) is directional, not significant: paired bootstrap 95% CI [-0.360, +0.008] over 20k resamples, Wilcoxon signed-rank p=0.20. Two of the largest regressions (hvac-control, mario-coin-counting) are tasks where reward_baseline was already at the 1.0 ceiling, where regression was the only available direction. Caveat: reward_baseline was not re-measured under the A0f harness, so this pairing crosses harness versions. 10 of 87 tasks measured so far; the rest will be appended to a future record as they run. Full methodology, per-task trial vectors, and caveats: results/a0f-full-vocab/summary.md on the skillsbench-history branch.
